items.title: 31.3 X-ray crystallography aur structure analysis (banawat ki jaanch) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of X-ray crystallography (PDF 223-224).

blocks.text: X-ray crystallography aik bohat strong (taqatwar) analytical tool (jaanch ka auzaar) hai jis se crystalline solid (jis mein atoms ba-qaida tarteeb mein hon) mein atoms ki three-dimensional (3D) positions (jagahein) maloom ki jati hain. Yeh material science, biochemistry aur pharmaceutical (dawaon ki) chemistry mein ahem hai, kyunke is se scientists materials ka structure (banawat) dekh sakte hain.

X-rays ki wavelength bohat chhoti hoti hai. Is liye yeh electromagnetic radiation kisi molecule ya ionic compound mein electrons aur atoms ki jagah maloom karne ke kaam aati hai. Solid materials atoms ki layers (tahon) ya strands (lariyon) se bane hote hain.
Jab source se X-rays crystal par parti hain to atoms se takra kar khaas angles (zawiyon) par diffract hoti hain (mur jati hain), jaisa Figure 31.4 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Do parallel aane wali X-rays (teer) red atoms ki rows (qataaron) mein, aik doosre ke oopar neeche d faasle par, do atoms se takrati hain aur rows se usi angle theta par diffracted X-rays ban kar nikalti hain. Oopar wale atom se pink perpendiculars (amood) neeche wali ray par atom se pehle aur baad d sin theta kaat'te hain; oopar wale atom par theta aur neeche wale par 2 theta. Diffracted rays ke saath pink bracket par '2d sin theta = total path length difference'.
blocks.caption: Figure 31.4: X-ray diffraction (kitab ki Figure 31.4 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche wali layer se lautne wali ray ko oopar wali ray se 'd sin theta' aate hue aur 'd sin theta' jaate hue zyada rasta tay karna parta hai, yani total extra path (izafi rasta) 2d sin theta. Jab yeh extra path wavelength ka poora multiple (guna) ho to rays aik doosre ko strong (mazboot) karti hain aur screen par roshan spot (nuqta) banta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 31.4 mein daen taraf 'Different X-rays' chhapa hai; sahi lafz 'Diffracted X-rays' hai, kyunke kitab ka apna text kehta hai ke X-rays atoms se takra kar diffract hoti hain. Hamari drawing mein diffracted X-rays dikhayi gayi hain.

Yeh diffracted rays screen par patterns banati hain jinhein diffraction patterns kehte hain. Diffraction pattern molecule mein atoms aur electrons ki jagah batata hai. Is se maps (naqshe) bante hain aur atoms ke darmiyan faasla maloom hota hai. Mathematical models aur pattern ke analysis ki madad se scientists crystal mein atoms ki positions aur bond angles ka detailed map bana lete hain. Yun atoms aur un ki electron density (electrons kahan zyada hain) ka complete (mukammal) map ban jata hai aur molecule ya crystal ka poora structure maloom ho jata hai. Naphthalene molecule ka structure Figure 31.5 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: naphthalene ka electron-density contour map: mota outer (bahari) contour jis mein hydrogen atoms ki jagah bumps (ubhaar) hain, rings ke beech do hexagonal (chhe-kone) khali hisse, aur das carbon atoms par nested (tah-dar) gol contours; leader lines 500 (andar aur bahar), 1000 aur 2000 dikhati hain. Daen: naphthalene ka structure, do jure six-membered (chhe atoms wale) rings (andar circles), das C aur aath H atoms.
blocks.caption: Figure 31.5: Naphthalene molecule ka diffraction pattern (kitab ki Figure 31.5 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen wala map batata hai ke molecule mein electrons kahan zyada hain: har gol nested contour aik carbon atom hai (beech mein sab se dense (ghana), 2000 se zyada), aur outer bumps hydrogen atoms hain jin ke paas electrons kam hain (sirf 500 wala contour). Rings ke beech khali hisse mein electron density kam hai. Is map se atoms ki positions naap kar daen wala structure banaya jata hai.

XRD ka sab se famous (mashhoor) use DNA ka double helix structure maloom karna hai. X-ray crystallography aaj bhi enzymes aur proteins jaise complex biomolecules ki jaanch mein kaam aati hai. Yeh pharmaceutical drug development (nayi dawaon ki tayyari) mein bhi use hoti hai: designers is se dekhte hain ke drug (dawa) ka molecule apne target se kaise jurta hai. Aik aur use materials aur minerals ki jaanch hai: minerals, synthetic crystals aur nanomaterials ka analysis. Is se electronics, optics aur construction mein materials ki performance behtar hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Crystal mein atoms ki jagah maloom karne ke liye X-rays kyun use hoti hain, aam roshni (visible light) kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: X-rays ki wavelength bohat chhoti hai, taqreeban atoms ke darmiyani faasle jitni, is liye atoms ki layers inhein diffract karti hain. Aam roshni ki wavelength bohat lambi hai, us se yeh pattern nahi banta.

blocks.prompt: X-ray crystallography ke do uses batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: DNA ki double helix structure; enzymes aur proteins ki jaanch; dawaon ki tayyari; minerals, synthetic crystals aur nanomaterials ka analysis.

items: XRD crystalline solid mein atoms ki 3D positions maloom karta hai.
Diffracted X-rays diffraction pattern banati hain; is se electron density ka map banta hai.
Uses: DNA, enzymes aur proteins, drugs (dawayein), minerals aur nanomaterials.
